content:
Returns a list of child containers associated with the specified user. You can retrieve a list of users
with the GET /users endpoint.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
Example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6
The UUID of the user you want to retrieve the list of child containers for.
